notes: `עַל־פְּנֵי` fuses to *upon* and `מִפְּנֵי` to *because of*, both single renderings under rule 30, each headed on the construct noun with the target head on the content word.
The three suffixes rendered *of thee* are read under rule 19's pronominal-rectum clause, headed on the pronoun, with the construct nouns keeping only their own word and a supplied *the*.
*that are under* keeps the supplied relative and copula with the preposition heading the predicate, rules 41 and 49.
